messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: surge of CUDA OOMs on streaming-decode pool 'decode-stream-1' starting 2026-03-15T09:00Z. 30% of nodes reporting kernel OOMs; automatic retries failing. Logs: `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` in decode loop. Link: https://internal.ops/alerts/4922220001

oncall_jordan: I'm on it. Can someone scope blast radius? are customer-facing endpoints affected?

sre_amy: Quick summary from telemetry: spike in per-request GPU mem allocations coincident with large kv-cache growth. 11 nodes showing repeated OOMs, 4 restarted by k8s. Error rate up ~18x for streaming endpoints. Early hypothesis: runaway generation from mis-set max_tokens header from a client.

eng_noah: Confirmed — saw a pattern: requests with X-Client-Max-Tokens: 1000000000 (1e9) repeatedly. Streaming loop doesn't early-stop due to header precedence bug. Patch idea: enforce server-side hard ceiling and drop requests exceeding 100k tokens. Immediate hotfix: apply per-request clamp middleware.

support_liam: Which customers hit? Ticketing shows two enterprise customers (acme-corp, betaapps) opened errors: hundreds of request failures each. CS is pinged.

eng_maya: Proposed mitigation steps (short-term):
1) Roll global middleware that clamps max_tokens to 100k.
2) Quarantine affected node group to prevent noisy neighbor restarts: `/ops quarantine-group decode-stream-1`
3) Trigger fallback routing to cpu-decoder for new streaming requests for tier=standard.

oncall_jordan: Do step 1 + 3 now. I'll coordinate quarantine with infra. Keep me posted.

eng_noah: Rolling clamp now (hotpatch). Patch payload:```json
{
  "middleware": "max_tokens_clamp",
  "hard_limit": 100000
}
```Applying to streaming route in prod...

incident-bot: DEPLOYMENT: max_tokens_clamp v1 applied to route streaming://decode (canary 10% -> 100%).

eng_maya: Kicking off `/ops quarantine-group decode-stream-1 --reason "excess-kv-growth"`

ops_tool: quarantine accepted: decode-stream-1 quarantined, traffic drained to fallback pools.

eng_noah: Started safe-drain script to evacuate active sessions where possible; note: long-running streaming sessions will be terminated if they exceed 60s drain window. Logs: ```
[2026-03-15T09:05:12Z] terminating session sess-88a3: exceeded-clamp
[2026-03-15T09:05:14Z] killed worker decode-03 due to oom
```

sre_amy: Telemetry after clamp/quarantine: OOM rate dropped ~92% within 3m. Error rate for streaming endpoints back to ~1.3x baseline. Node restarts stopped.

support_liam: Customer update draft: "We experienced service interruptions on streaming inference due to unusually large generation requests. We applied mitigations and are routing traffic to fallback pools. We're investigating and will share a timeline." Need approvals before sending to acme-corp and betaapps.

pm_dana: Approve. Add note about token limits and recommended client-side validation; offer 1:1 sync for impacted customers.

eng_maya: Root cause note for triage: bug in header precedence logic allowed X-Client-Max-Tokens to override server-side route config. Combined with lack of a server-side hard ceiling, client-sent 1e9 caused unbounded decode attempts leading to kv cache growth and eventual CUDA mem exhaustion.

oncall_jordan: Handoff: I'm paging eng_maya and eng_noah for post-incident work. I'll update the incident channel and schedule a postmortem for tomorrow 10:30 UTC. Oncall continues monitoring for 2 hours.

eng_noah: Follow-ups I've queued:
- PR to add server-side enforcement and unit tests (ref: repo/platform/serving#8246)
- Add synthetic test simulating maliciously large max_tokens to CI load tests
- Add alert: sustained per-request token allocation > 1e6 for >5m -> pager

eng_maya: Also adding a fast rollback path for header precedence change if we see client regressions.

support_liam: I'll update the open tickets with mitigation notes and ETA for root cause analysis. Logged ~1,250 failed requests across both customers; severity elevated.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigations applied. Priority -> P2. Monitoring window 2h. Postmortem assigned to eng_maya, eng_noah, sre_amy.

oncall_jordan: Thanks team. Marking handoff to eng_maya. tagging: @eng_maya @eng_noah @sre_amy. :thumbsup:

eng_maya: Acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem and customer communication artifacts. Creating doc: https://internal.postmortems/4922220001-kv-growth-max-tokens

eng_noah: leaving notes in runbook: add "always enforce server hard token ceiling" under decode streaming playbook.

support_liam: Closing loop: customer ACME support contact confirmed they see retries and are ok with mitigation; BetaApps requested a postmortem.

sre_amy: I'll keep an eye on mem graphs for the next hour. Current snapshot: GPU mem tail usage down to nominal.

oncall_jordan: Handing off monitoring to day oncall. If anything spikes, re-open page. Closing thread for now.
